text:
Aria P.: quick announcement: new release-train policy + a short rollback drill next Tuesday. summary below — read and ack if you have scheduled rollouts.
Raj K.: drill? scope?
Aria P.: drill is for releases touching model-serving or routing. timeline: Tue 2026-09-14 09:00-11:00 UTC. During the drill we will simulate a 3% error spike and verify auto-pause + rollback automation. This is a heads-up so teams can avoid scheduling risky migrations then.
deploy-bot: scheduled_drill: release-rollback-drill-2026-09-14T09:00:00Z -> 2026-09-14T11:00:00Z. Automated rollback test will be executed in canary zones only.
Sam T.: will the drill touch production traffic?
Aria P.: no direct user traffic will be impacted. We will run canary-level simulations and validate alerting paths + runbook execution.
Raj K.: also rolling out a small policy change: effective immediately, any release PR must include `release.monitoring` tag with at least two verification queries and SLO targets. No tag = no schedule.
release-manager: adding process note: if the automated rollback triggers during the drill, we expect team owners to investigate within 15 minutes. If unresolved after 15m, ops will escalate and capture a rollback postmortem.
infra-bot: new_canary_policy applied: "max_traffic_pct": "4", "auto_pause_error_uplift": "2.0", "pause_window_mins": "8", "escalation_mins": "12". Ops will enforce for the drill and for next week's release windows.
Sam T.: can you paste the exact config snippet we should add to release PRs?
Aria P.: snippet below — add as a code block in the PR description: ```
canary: {
  max_traffic_pct: 4,
  auto_pause_error_uplift: 2.0,
  pause_window_mins: 8,
  escalation_mins: 12
}
monitoring: ["latency_p50","error_rate"]
SLOs: {"error_rate_pct": "<0.5"}
```
Raj K.: exec update: CTO will join the post-drill readout to review rollback maturity and SLA implications. Please make sure the postmortem draft is ready within 48 hours if any automated rollback occurs.
release-manager: final note: if you have long-running experiments or infra migrations planned for Sep 13-15, mark them here now. We'll take a hard look and reschedule anything risky.
Aria P.: thanks — please ack this thread and ping me directly if you need an exemption. :eyes:
Sam T.: ACK, I have a config-only client update scheduled on Sep 14 but it
oesn't touch serving. Ian move it to Sep 15.
Raj K.: ACK. I have a schema migration planned Sep 15 that touches routing; will re-file for review and move post-drill.
deploy-bot: note: release-train calendar updated; pinned note will appear in #eng-notices.
